caption:
"I was refused once. Is that it?" No. But what you do next decides a lot.

A refusal is on your record and future officers can see it. That is real. What it is not is a permanent disqualification.

What damages your position is a pattern — repeated refusals on the same unaddressed weakness. One refusal, properly diagnosed and fixed, is recoverable.
